proyecto_1_descripcion: A solution concept designed to centralize production workflows, operational tracking, and integration across editorial teams and technical processes.
proyecto_2_descripcion: Initial design for an API- and service-oriented solution to modernize academic operations, document traceability, and automation of key tasks.
proyecto_sipro_descripcion: A multi-agent educational platform was designed to address the need to strengthen higher education students’ competencies for the Saber Pro exams. The solution automates the generation of adaptive assessments and personalized learning paths, integrating AI, progress analytics, and a full-stack architecture built with Next.js, FastAPI, and Supabase.
proyecto_editorial_unisabana_descripcion: An ecommerce solution was defined and developed for an academic publishing imprint, starting from an analysis and consulting process to determine the most suitable architecture. proyecto_medicalcare_descripcion: A web application was structured to solve the end-to-end management needs of a medical center by connecting clinical and administrative workflows in a single platform. The solution included modules for members, medical staff, and administrators, built on a full-stack architecture with React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL to centralize operations and improve traceability.
proyecto_cv_camilo_descripcion: A bilingual professional website was designed and developed as a personal positioning tool aimed at projecting my profile toward Software Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and Backend Development. The solution brings together responsive design, SEO, multilingual experience, and PDF generation to communicate value proposition, trajectory, and projects in a scalable format.
